title: Praxis provenance actor
description: The portable, self-reported identity of whoever performed an action (RQ-ROS-2026-A001). Provenance, not authentication: it records who claims to have acted, and is cross-checked against the execution record, but is not cryptographic proof. provider/model/runtime are omitted when not applicable (a human) and are the literal "unknown" when applicable but not known.

kind.description: agent: autonomous or semi-autonomous AI system; human; automation: deterministic non-agent process such as CI; unknown; or a namespaced x-... extension.

id.description: Stable identity across executions: an explicit agent/actor ID, else provider/runtime for a non-human actor whose provider and runtime are known, else "unknown".
